title: Source: src/agent_runtime/kv
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/kv

src/agent_runtime/kv/init.py

Python · Tier A

Expose KVStore and KVError for storage consumers. The facade selects the active RAM owner or standalone SQLite only when constructed; importing this package performs no scratch read/write, scope binding or inference.

src/agent_runtime/kv/lifecycle.py

Python · Tier A

Retire scratch scopes in the same transaction as accepted task/conversation deletion. scopes_for_runs captures indexed ownership and deterministic fallback scopes before their rows disappear; exclusive mode preserves scopes still owned by another run. retire_scopes_in fences late access immediately and optionally erases values/counters through the SQL or RAM owner. This layer does not infer authority from chat chronology or start its own transaction.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
scopes_for_runs 21 Collect task-derived scopes and indexed run ownership before deletion removes the binding rows. Unbound runs use their deterministic run-root fallback. With exclusive=True, retain only scopes with no owner outside the selected runs; this prevents deleting a shared continuation scope. Read through RAM Records or the allowed native SQL alias without mutating ownership.
retire_scopes_in 47 Join the caller-owned deletion transaction to fence each scope against late access. A fence-only pass retains values for later collection; full retirement removes entries and revision counters. RAM uses the hub KV repository and silently skips an absent owner, while SQL requires the existing attached kv_db.

src/agent_runtime/kv/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Own task scratch notes in the Controller RAM hub. MemoryKVStore publishes per-scope revisions, lazy expiry, quota checks and note changes atomically, then emits value-free metadata outside the transaction. Explicit reads return values, search returns bounded snippets and list returns keys. Deletion retains a scope tombstone; repository shares one owner per hub/recovery path. Legacy conversation column names remain for compatibility, but current tool scope comes from accepted task ownership. Live SQL access is forbidden.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
delete_conversation_in 36 Use the caller Records transaction to publish the scope tombstone and erase its entries and counter together. The legacy conversation_id field carries a task scope for current writes; sibling scopes are untouched.
MemoryKVStore 48 Own bounded task scratch notes in the Controller RAM hub. Records publish expiry, revisions, quota decisions and writes atomically; the SQLite path is recovery storage. Each API receives an authoritative scope from its caller and emits value-free metadata only after commit.
MemoryKVStore._operate 97 Validate scope, capture one time and atomically reject tombstones, expire old notes and apply the callback. A callback failure rolls back expiry too. Publish queued events after commit and suppress observer failures so they cannot undo accepted state.
MemoryKVStore.put 137 Validate exact text/revision/TTL inputs, then perform compare-and-set, per-scope capacity accounting and replacement in one hub transaction. Every successful put allocates a revision, even for identical content; omitted TTL clears expiration. Secret rejection is a retained no- op, and source_run_id is provenance only.
MemoryKVStore.get 206 Return the exact unexpired value and revision, or found=false, after ordinary scope fencing and lazy expiry. Reading a note does not establish current external facts.
MemoryKVStore.delete 222 Optionally compare the live revision and remove one key atomically. Missing unconditional deletes return deleted=false; conditional absence conflicts, and the allocator is retained to prevent revision reuse.
MemoryKVStore.list 238 Validate a literal normalized prefix, limit and prefix-bound lexical cursor, then return at most 100 keys without values. Cursors contain no scope authority or frozen snapshot; subsequent calls see current unexpired rows.
MemoryKVStore.search 281 Validate bounded search text and return up to 25 lexically ordered matches from the capped live scope. Distinct casefolded whitespace terms must all occur in key/value text; matching is substring-based and does not interpret wildcards.
MemoryKVStore.delete_conversation 331 Commit full retirement of one legacy/task scope through the hub, preserving a value-free tombstone against future operations.
repository 338 Reuse the hub singleton only for the same normalized recovery path, otherwise raise StateUnavailable. The clock is selected on first construction; later facade calls reuse that owner.

src/agent_runtime/kv/models.py

Python · Tier A

Define shared validation and capacity limits for task scratch notes. normalize_key lowercases exact bounded ASCII identities; validate_value preserves valid Unicode text under a 16 KiB UTF-8 limit; positive_integer rejects booleans and coerced revisions/TTLs. KVError carries stable diagnostic kinds. reject_secrets is a compatibility no-op, so guidance about non-secret scratch work is not enforced by this validator. No storage, redaction or model calls occur here.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
KVError 25 Expose a stable kind/error_kind alongside the caller-supplied diagnostic message. Store validation uses centralized messages rather than copying submitted note values.
normalize_key 35 Validate the exact ASCII key grammar before lowercasing it; whitespace is not trimmed. Only the prefix path accepts an empty string. Invalid input raises invalid_key without consulting storage.
positive_integer 47 Accept exact positive integers within an optional upper bound, excluding booleans and coercible strings/floats. None is accepted only for optional arguments.
reject_secrets 60 Retain the compatibility input-guard signature without rejecting any input. KV guidance recommends non-secret scratch data, but this function performs no classification or masking.
validate_value 67 Require text without NUL, encodable as UTF-8 and no larger than 16 KiB. Return its byte length for atomic capacity accounting; empty text is allowed, and secret-shaped strings are not independently rejected.

src/agent_runtime/kv/store.py

Python · Tier A

Provide the KVStore owner-routing facade, standalone SQLite operations and recovery schema initializer. Construction returns an explicit/registered RAM owner first; unowned paths use local SQL transactions. Both backends enforce text/byte/count bounds, per-task monotonic put revisions, optional compare-and-set, lazy expiry and deletion fences. Search scans capped key/value text and list uses lexical cursors. The caller supplies scope authority; historical column names do not give conversations access to current task notes.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
store_path 67 Locate the profile scratch recovery file beside native run state, independently of Gateway roots and per-task scope identities.
initialize_kv_schema 75 Initialize supported version-two recovery/standalone tables under an immediate transaction. Retain legacy conversation field names and the fixed conversation scope literal while current callers supply task-owned identities; the connection owner commits or rolls back.
KVStore 110 Route construction to a registered Controller RAM owner, or provide standalone SQLite note operations. Both implementations use task-scope counters, lazy expiry, revision checks, strict bounds and deletion tombstones; the facade itself does not infer user/task authorization.
KVStore.put 195 Validate key/text and optional revision/TTL before entering the scope transaction. Compare the live revision, account replacement bytes/count, allocate a new revision and replace atomically. Identical puts still change revision; omitted TTL clears expiration and writes return metadata only.
KVStore.get 271 Read the exact live note after scope fencing/expiry, returning found=false for ordinary absence and a value-bearing historical result when present.
KVStore.delete 287 Delete one live key after optional compare-and-set, retaining the scope allocator. Missing unconditional deletes succeed with deleted=false; a supplied revision makes absence a conflict.
KVStore.list 307 Page canonical keys using a validated literal prefix and prefix-bound lexical cursor, without reading values. The cursor grants no scope access and does not pin a snapshot; a limit-plus- one query determines continuation.
KVStore.search 357 Scan the bounded live scope in canonical key order, requiring every casefolded whitespace term as a literal substring of key/value text. Return original-Unicode snippets under 512 characters and at most 25 matches plus has_more; no ranking or wildcard query language is used.
KVStore.delete_conversation_in 408 Retire one task/legacy scope inside the caller transaction: route Records to the RAM owner, or validate the SQL alias and publish a tombstone before deleting notes and the counter. This helper does not commit the surrounding deletion.
KVStore.delete_conversation 430 Run standalone scope retirement in an immediate transaction, permanently fencing late reads and writes to that identity.
